fixture.description: One unrotated 600 by 800 page with a solid background. 12,000 Helvetica 12-point runs positioned at x=40 and y=750 minus 18 times the line index modulo 26. Labels are Ordinary line followed by the zero-based index, except lines 7 and 572 use Matching item.

method: Use three fresh Chromium pages per split build with a 1280 by 800 viewport at device pixel ratio 1 and an 800 by 600 preview host in contain mode. Wait for all text and both search hits. Measure each setScale call until a new canvas is painted and the active text mark is present. Count GetTextContent worker messages and newly added text spans.
